_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
D umarir {player_id} i keccek ɣ Tic Tac Toe.
Tafugar-k iɣerbazen kan kkat-in (s anẓa, s aɣerbani, neɣ s anẓul) ɣ trabbut.
Mi d-tekkiḍ, ilaq ad tferneḍ inumiren n takurt (0-8) iɣ tebɣid ad tesḍeḍ azamul-k inna.
Amɣar, '[4]' ad isḍi azamul-k ɣ tazwara n trabbut.
D umarir {player_id}, ad tiliḍ '{symbol}', ma d anḍad-k ad ig '{opponent_symbol}'.
